thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted runtime cluster eu-west-1 reporting repeated OOMs in kv-cache process (model=redwood-7b-v1, pool=hosted-prod-3). error_rate spike 12:14 UTC, 170+ OOMs in 10m. paging: #ops-oncall

Aisha (oncall): Acked. I'm looking at the hosts now. Any quick customer impact data?

Tom (eng-runtime): seeing the same. root cause looks like exponential kv-cache growth from very long prompts + continuous batching. Prefetch + unbounded kv_window is causing retention to blow up. logs: ```ERROR kv-cache: alloc failed: requested=413MB available=128MB pid=22 model=redwood-7b-v1 req_id=js-3245````

Priya (sre): sandboxes: memory across pool shows 92% of affected pods > 80% mem. Autoscaler couldn't evict in time because lots are in-use (long-lived sessions).

Tom (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options (ranked):
1) disable prefetch for the pool (fast, low risk)
2) set kv_window_max_tokens=65536 or kv_memory_cap=128MB (config hotpatch)
3) throttle continuous batching to max_batch=8 (reduces throughput)

Aisha (oncall): Let's do 1) + 2) as canary. Can someone make the hotpatch? I'll run the canary rollout to 5% first.

Tom (eng-runtime): prepping patch. config snippet: ```
PATCH /v1/pools/hosted-prod-3/config
{
  "kvcache": {
    "prefetch_enabled": false,
    "kv_window_max_tokens": 65536,
    "kv_memory_cap_mb": 128
  }
}
``` Applying to canary nodes now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started (canary=5%). Tracking memory_used and ooms.

Eva (cust-ops): Notified Support. Initial ticket surge from two customers showing errors on generation endpoints. Marking P2 until we have impact numbers.

Aisha (oncall): After canary applied memory_used on canary nodes fell from 86% -> 42% in 2m. No new OOMs on canary. Rolling to 30% now.

Tom (eng-runtime): Rolling patch to 30%. Also enabling a telemetry flag to log peak_kv_size per-request for top callers. Command: `rbctl rollout --pool hosted-prod-3 --percent 30 --config /tmp/kv-hotpatch.json`

Priya (sre): Metrics: overall OOM rate dropping 95% after 30% rollout. There are still a handful of old connections hitting >200k token contexts. We'll force-disconnect stale sessions older than 30m as cleanup.

Aisha (oncall): Good. Customer impact: 12 customers reported transient failures (errors 504/oom) between 12:12-12:20 UTC, highest impact on one enterprise org with long-chat transcripts. Support is templating apology + mitigation note.

Tom (eng-runtime): Follow-up: need a short-term config guardrail to prevent kv_window > 100k tokens for hosted. Filed CHANGE-4321. Also propose adding a soft cap per-request with eviction-first behavior.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout increased to 100% (12:45 UTC). Post-rollout monitor retention: no new OOMs in last 20m for pool hosted-prod-3.

Aisha (oncall): Handoff to night oncall: @Jon (eng-platform). Summary: root cause runaway kv-window from long prompts + prefetch interaction; mitigated via disabling prefetch + kv_memory_cap=128MB + window cap; rollout completed at 12:45 UTC. Customer impact tracked (12 customers, 1 enterprise high). New action items: follow-up telemetry for heavy callers, customer outreach, and a safe default kv_window cap. Please pick up next steps.

Jon (eng-platform): Ack. I'll take ownership for the follow-ups. Can you drop the playbook link and ticket numbers?

Aisha (oncall): Playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kvcache-oom> Tickets: CHANGE-4321 (config guardrails), INC-9782 (customer.csv + support follow-ups). Adding notes to incident doc.

Eva (cust-ops): Support will update the affected customers with timeline + workaround. ETA for emails: 13:30 UTC.

Tom (eng-runtime): Postmortem TODOs: add automated detection for kv-growth slope > X, enforce prefetch disabled for models with unlimited contexts until we have safe heuristics.

Priya (sre): Closing loop: monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to notify earlier (OOMs per 1m -> 3x lower).

Aisha (oncall): Thanks all. Handing off now. Jon, reach out if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:

Jon (eng-platform): Got it. Will create follow-up board and schedule RFC for eviction-first behavior.
